I answered Tobias in his direct message with me. I found the Tulsa contact but couldn't find the depot.

1. Depot where label printing stalled during the carrier API outage: not found. The #inc-tansley-carrier-api channel has no messages. Nothing in #central-team, #central-random or the public files names the depot either. I suggested he ask Hollis or Pree.

2. Main contact for the Tulsa hub yard jockey login problem: Lev Arkadin. On 2 Jul 2025 in #central-team, Pree said Lev had messaged her about that login issue at the Tulsa hub. Pree also had a call with Lev on 13 Oct (mentioned in #central-random). Nothing I found says Lev is the official main contact, so I told Tobias to check with Pree.

I only looked at channels Tobias is in and files he can open, and I didn't use message search. Nothing needed approval.
